## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 4-fascicle text by [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) Bodhiruci is a *śāstra* (treatise) on the *Mahā-ratnakūṭa* tradition — i.e. on the *Bǎojī*-cycle of Mahāyāna sūtras (cf. [the great compendium T0310](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)), whose Indic original is attributed to [婆藪槃豆菩薩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A9%86%E8%97%AA%E6%A7%83%E8%B1%86%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9) Vasubandhu / [安慧](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E6%85%A7) Sthiramati. The treatise was translated into Chinese by Bodhiruci in the early Northern-Wèi period.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) Bodhiruci's Northern-Wèi activity in Luòyáng (508 – 537 CE).

The Taishō text (T1523) is established on the standard apparatus.
